description: Beredskapsdepoter is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kystverket. Statlige depoter med oljevernutstyr. Stedfestingen er knyttet opp mot stedsnavn og er derfor ikke helt nøyaktig. Inneholder lenker til materielllister. Datasettet inngår også i Kystverkets WMS. Coverage: Kystverket. The publisher named on the listing is Kystverket. Its keywords include Forurensning, Svalbard, Oljevern, Samfunnssikkerhet, modellbaserteVegprosjekter, Norge digitalt. The listing shows 5 download or service links in TXT, GML, GEOJSON, SHP. The listing shows 2020-11-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
